title: Phantasm
description:
## **Phantasm** — live actors for Skyrim menus

A renderer that draws Skyrim's characters and items on their own: posed, lit and framed, for pages and pictures instead of the game's own view.

**Coming to SkyrimNet**
- In SkyrimNet's next release, OmniSight takes its pictures of characters and items through Phantasm, so the descriptions SkyrimNet writes come from a clean, well-lit shot of the person or the gear, not whatever happens to be on screen.

**In SeverActions**
- Draws the Outfits mirror, the 3D item views and the automatic faces you see across its pages.

**For mod authors**
- Other mods can use it through a small C API.

## Works on Skyrim SE, AE and VR.
author: severause
